mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.user_id, a.notifications_id, a.`read`, a.read_time, b.title, b.content, b.publish_time, c.username, c.account FROM sys_notifications_record a INNER JOIN sys_notifications b ON a.notifications_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON a.user_id = c.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}
